messages:
lena (support): Hey team — hitting an escalation. Customer (marcus) says Python SDK streaming generator hangs mid-response. They also see intermittent 401s during long streams and strange micro-billing spikes. Repro steps included.

marcus (customer): I can repro reliably with our prompt. Example output shows an SSE 'data:' split across packets:
```
data: {"role":"assistant","delta":"Hel

[data cut] then next packet:
data: lo"}

then the generator never yields the rest. We also got a 401 a few seconds into the stream after a token refresh. Billing shows ~10 tiny token charges instead of one stream charge.
```

sam (eng-runtime): Thanks, Marcus. Quick Qs: which python-sdk version? are you behind a proxy or HTTP/2 gRPC gateway? Any custom keepalive config?

marcus (customer): python SDK v0.7.3, plain requests over HTTPS (no proxy), running inside a short-lived lambda that rotates creds via our local refresher. No special keepalive settings.

lena (support): Noted. Looks like two failures overlapping: 1) SSE framing split (partial token emitted across TCP frames) causing our generator to block waiting for closing newline delimiter; 2) auth refresh triggered a 401 mid-stream which the client retries and ends up re-opening connections and creating many short billing windows.

sam (eng-runtime): Hypothesis: our SSE parser expects events to end with "\n\n" and will wait if delimiter never arrives. If an auth refresh inserts a 401 or a connection reset during a partial event, the generator awaiting the remainder never yields and the client code doesn't surface a clear exception. Also possible race where the auth rotation writes an interim empty heartbeat.

lena (support): Marcus provided a minimal repro script:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
gen = client.chat.stream(model='redwood-large', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'long output please'}])
for chunk in gen:
    print(chunk)
```
When the auth refresher runs mid-stream, it shows the partial output then hang.

ops (eng-oncall): Can you attach the raw HTTP capture (curl -v / tcpdump) or the SDK DEBUG logs? We need the socket-level sequence.

marcus (customer): Attached logs (trimmed). I see:
```
...
<- 0x... "data: {\"delta\":\"Hel" 

<- TCP FIN/RESET
-> GET /v1/stream ... Authorization: Bearer <rotated token>
<- 401 Unauthorized
<- connection closed
```

sam (eng-runtime): That matches. Short-term mitigation: upgrade to python-sdk v0.7.5 (we pushed a parser tolerance patch) which flushes partial data when connection closes and raises a recoverable StreamInterruptedError so app can retry instead of hanging. Also we've added a server-side sticky auth period to avoid mid-stream 401 during token rotation.

lena (support): Actions: 1) ask customer to try v0.7.5 (we'll provide wheel) 2) ops to trace billing for that customer session to merge micro-charges (possible billing-side debounce) 3) eng-runtime to investigate auth refresh edge and add more robust reconnection semantics.

sam (eng-runtime): Filed ENG-1348. Proposed SDK patch included in PR: add buffer-on-close behavior in sse.py and emit explicit exception on mid-event connection close. Quick patch snippet:
```python
# sse.py (simplified)
if eof and buffer:
    # treat partial as final event instead of blocking
    emit(parse_event(buffer))
    raise StreamInterruptedError('connection closed during event')
```

We also incremented default backoff/retry to avoid duplicate micro-billing.

lena (support): Marcus — can you confirm if you want us to schedule a brief debug session? We can provide the patched wheel and monitor billing while you test. :thumbsup:

marcus (customer): Yes please. Send the wheel and let's test this afternoon. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

dev-bot: Uploaded artifact redwood_python-0.7.5-patch1.whl to S3 (private link)

lena (support): Great — we'll follow up with a short runbook and a postmortem if needed. Marking as high-priority until customer validates.

sam (eng-runtime): FYI we'll aim for a non-breaking 0.7.5 release and a separate 0.8.0 improvement for stronger auth session guarantees.

lena (support): Thanks all — tracking in support ticket SUP-8421.
